title: What a new freight broker should focus on first
seoTitle: What a new freight broker should focus on first
searchIntent: What should a new freight broker focus on first?
excerpt: Build regular quote opportunities, learn to execute the first shipments and add systems around work you understand.
takeaway: Focus first on qualified shippers who will ask you for quotes, then on executing early shipments well. Add people and systems in response to a real operating need.

sections.title: What should a new freight broker focus on first?
paragraphs: Luis sees new brokers getting pulled toward software, office space and hiring before they have a repeatable way to win work. His first coaching milestone is a small group of shippers who regularly ask for quotes. That gives the sales effort a practical target.

In the lesson, he suggests five to ten such relationships. The number is a coaching example, not an industry benchmark or a guarantee of success. The useful change is to measure relevant conversations and quote opportunities rather than only a distant income goal.

sections.title: Turn the goal into a sales routine
paragraphs: Research companies, contact the appropriate people and follow up on the conversations you have earned. Find out what they ship, who controls the freight and how a new provider can be considered. Keep the next action visible.

A quote request is an opportunity to understand the work. Gather the shipment requirements and learn to price responsibly. Avoid substituting a cheap, unsupported number for a genuine plan to arrange transportation.

sections.title: Learn the full process through early shipments
paragraphs: Luis’s second milestone is completing the first ten loads. His point is to gain practical experience with the full sequence: customer requirements, carrier selection, booking, tracking, delivery documents and payment.

Treat those loads as real commitments. Meet the applicable authority, contract and insurance requirements before arranging freight, and do not take unsuitable work simply to reach a count. Review what went well and what needs to change after each move.

sections.title: Add systems around a demonstrated need
paragraphs: Once work is coming in, identify the tasks that limit your ability to sell or deliver service. A better workflow, appropriate software or support person can then solve a specific problem.

Ten loads do not automatically mean the business is ready for agents or employees. Evaluate cash, workload and your ability to support another person. Luis’s broader lesson is to work on the stage you are actually in, instead of copying the structure of a much larger brokerage.
